reason: The 'no effect' conclusion rests on an unjustified north-only subsample (N=634) with a wide CI that includes positive effects; on the full sample (N=2000) with the same or fuller pre-period controls, the coefficient is about 0.69 (SE 0.24, p=0.004), and it is positive in every region. A non-significant result in one subsample is not evidence of no effect.
